dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Good afternoon, Bright Smile Dental. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment for a checkup, please. I've had a toothache for a few days.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Of course. Are you an existing patient with us?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes — Alex Chen. I last came in about a year ago.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Thanks. We're pretty booked up this week, but I have Thursday at 3:30 or Friday at 10. Which works for you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Thursday at 3:30 works for me. Do I need to bring anything?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Just your ID and insurance card if you have one. We'll see you then.

expressions.zh: 预约（看病、会面等）。剑桥例句：*I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Evans, please.*
牙痛。剑桥常见说法：*I have terrible toothache.*
已约满 / 没空档（活动、航班、诊所时段等）。
（某个时间或安排）对我合适 / 行得通。
